name: Yugyouji Yoruko
source:
"Shut up!"

Class 2, Grade 1, Fujitsubo School (not going to school)

A girl who likes books more than anyone and more than anything. With the peculiar appearance of white hair and red eyes, she used to be looked at with vigilant eyes, and is thus hostile to others. That is why she has fostered a love for books which never betray her.

She was wary of the protagonist when they first met, and a chilly atmosphere arose between them. As a result, she opposes the protagonist entering the library, and bears dissatisfaction with other family members who welcome him.

She is reserved and mysteriously charming. She spends every day in the library, buried in books.

[Translated from [url=http://kagura.rdy.jp/kamimaho/character.html]official website[/url]]
